audience.en: Expat families in HCMC planning a birth, worked through for a couple: Tom, 37, who is British, and Anh, 34, who is Vietnamese.
audience.zh: 在胡志明市规划生育保障的外籍家庭；以一对夫妻为例：英国籍的 Tom，37 岁，和越南籍的 Anh，34 岁。

localeReason: Simplified Chinese is genuinely useful for Chinese-speaking expat families navigating HCMC BHYT, inpatient/private cover and newborn gaps. Translation preserves the British/Vietnamese parents, Thu Duc residence, work-permit/contract questions, March 2027 first birth and USD 5,000 annual private-cover budget. No Chinese citizenship, infant nationality, employment eligibility or acceptance is inferred.
